No convergence to sigma, unique stationary state, spectral gap, or commuting
of Psi with Phi is assumed. The globally valid same-Psi inequality (P), not
only its value at the original rho, is what permits this integral.

Since Phi-I commutes with P_s, trace contraction on Hermitian differences
in the exact Duhamel formula gives
 T(rho_t,rho)<=t b_rho.
For the SAME CPTP Psi, e_Psi is 2-Lipschitz in half-trace distance. Therefore
 e_Psi,R(rho_t)>=(e_rho-2tb_rho)_+.
When b_rho>0, the complete cone has exact area
 integral_0^infinity(e_rho-2tb_rho)_+^2dt=e_rho^3/(6b_rho).
Combine with (I) to obtain (S), with 6*16A_Q/pi=96A_Q/pi.
When b_rho=0 the constant orbit and finite integral force e_rho=0, without
dividing by b_rho. When D=0 the state is the fixed product reference.

For singular rho, regularize by rho_epsilon=(1-epsilon)rho+epsilon omega,
omega=tau_R tensor sigma. Phi and Psi both fix omega, so both half-errors
scale exactly by 1-epsilon. D to the fixed faithful finite omega is
continuous, and taking epsilon down to zero proves the result on every
state. To choose tau_R=rho_R, first restrict to supp(rho_R), on which it is
faithful; the idle map preserves that support. This changes no local map.

6. Raw theorem: fixed marginal and arbitrary finite quantum references.

In fact, fix ANY one raw broadcaster and faithful sigma. The construction
below chooses Psi from those data ONLY, before any tested family is selected.
For EVERY finite R and EVERY state rho_RB with rho_B=sigma, put
 b_rho=max_j T[rho,(id_R tensor mathcal B_raw,j)rho].
The SAME Psi simultaneously satisfies the stronger pointwise form
 e_rho^3<=(96A_Q/pi)I(R:B)_rho[b_rho+sqrt(delta)+delta/2]
          <=(240A_Q/pi)I(R:B)_rho sqrt(b_rho),          (RAW-POINT)
where the ONE fixed delta below obeys delta<=b_rho for every such state.
No information budget or family is used to choose this comparator.

Fix sigma>0 on finite B. Let F be ANY nonempty family of joint states rho_i
on R_i tensor B, with arbitrary finite R_i (possibly unbounded dimensions),
each local marginal (rho_i)_B=sigma, and
 C=sup_i I(R_i:B)_{rho_i}<infinity.
Let ONE full-domain raw broadcaster mathcal B_raw:B->B tensor B satisfy
 sup_i max_{j=1,2} T[rho_i,(id_Ri tensor mathcal B_raw,j)rho_i]<=b, 0<=b<=1.
Its two marginals may differ, may not fix sigma, and need not be KMS.
